description: Open-source AI/ML platform hosting millions of models, datasets and Spaces used by 18M+ developers ($150M ARR). Agreed to be acquired by NVIDIA for $12.9B, Nvidia's second-largest purchase ever; Hugging Face is set to keep operating independently and supporting open-weight models.

target: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC)
description: Singapore-headquartered data-centre operator running a ~2.3GW platform across 12 global markets. A KKR-led consortium with Singtel acquired the remaining 82% stake from Temasek's ST Telemedia, taking full ownership at an implied enterprise value of ~S$13.8B (~$10.9B); KKR now holds 75%, Singtel 25%.

target: Brookfield Investment Solutions Group (Nuclear Liabilities Fund mandate)
description: Brookfield's Investment Solutions Group manages outsourced multi-asset mandates for institutional clients. It was selected by the UK's Nuclear Liabilities Fund (which covers nuclear decommissioning costs) for a multi-decade investment mandate with an initial $1B (~£750M) commitment, announced September 8, 2026.

Trapped-ion quantum computing company (Honeywell/Cambridge Quantum lineage). Finalized a $100M CHIPS and Science Act R&D award from the US Department of Commerce to advance domestic manufacturing of ion-trap hardware, cryogenic semiconductors and optical components, working with GlobalFoundries on fabrication and NIST on metrology.

Publicly traded (NASDAQ: QBTS) quantum computing company building annealing and gate-model systems. Finalized a $100M CHIPS Act R&D award from the US Department of Commerce for quantum-semiconductor process work toward a 100,000-qubit annealing system and a 10,000-qubit gate-model system; Commerce receives a minority equity stake as a funding condition.

AI research lab founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati. As of early September 2026, NVIDIA was reportedly in talks to anchor roughly $2.5B of a $5-6B round at a ~$40B valuation, extending a partnership that already includes a multi-year deal to deploy at least 1GW of NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems. Deal was not yet confirmed closed at time of writing.

Fintech (formerly Rent App) that splits a renter's, homeowner's or other biller's large monthly bill into two payments, fronting up to 50% for up to 30 days for a fee. Raised $125M across Series A and B, led by Khosla Ventures with Thrive Capital and Max Levchin participating; says usage grew 70x in the prior year.

AI-native registered investment advisor (RIA) platform for independent financial advisors, overseeing ~$9B in client AUM across 150+ advisors. Closed a $100M Series C led by Ryan Smith and Ryan Sweeney's Halo Fund, with existing backer Thrive Capital and others participating, at a $600M valuation.

Rhode Island maker of the Viceroy 'Seaglider,' an electric flying boat that operates under maritime rather than aviation law, plus an autonomous military variant (Squire). Raised $240M Series B (half equity, half debt) co-led by Mare Liberum and AE Ventures, with Founders Fund, Lockheed Martin Ventures and Japan Airlines among backers.

AI research lab founded by Ritankar Das with Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus, building 'computer-use' models that let AI agents operate office software directly; its Hive-32B model claims to beat larger rivals on computer-use benchmarks. As of July 2026, in talks to raise $100M at a ~$1B valuation.

AI-native third-party administrator (TPA) unifying benefits administration, claims processing, care orchestration and member support for self-insured employers; has processed $600M+ in claims across 25,000+ members. Raised $14M combined pre-seed/seed led by Khosla Ventures, with Long Journey Ventures and Superior Studios.

Superhot-rock engineered geothermal company; holds the record for the hottest engineered geothermal system built (629°F/331°C at Newberry, Oregon, 2025), targeting 15MW horizontal wells. Raised $135M led by Centaurus Capital and Doerr Capital, joined by ConocoPhillips, Shell Ventures and repeat backer Khosla Ventures.

AI-native B2B marketplace (New York, founded by ex-Instacart's Camille van Horne) that lets beauty brands discreetly resell surplus inventory to vetted buyers; has listed $1B+ in goods across 100+ brands. Raised $30M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with plans to expand into apparel.

Enterprise AI platform ('Droids') for autonomous software development — code review, testing, debugging and incident response. Raised $200M at a $5B valuation (up from $1.5B in April 2026), with Sequoia, Khosla Ventures, Blackstone and Clearlake among backers, bringing total funding past $400M.

Bulgaria-founded space company making standardized, software-flexible small satellites and offering constellations-as-a-service to 450+ customers. Raised $205M co-led by Riot Ventures and Atreides Management, with Google Ventures (GV), Founders Fund and Lux Capital among backers, to open a US manufacturing facility and an EU space/defense hub.

Vertically integrated AI infrastructure company building large-scale data-center campuses and modular 'Crusoe Spark' AI factories (an OpenAI Stargate partner). Announced an oversubscribed $3.9B Series F initial close at a $30.9B valuation, co-led by Atreides Management, Mubadala Capital and Valor Equity, with NVIDIA, Founders Fund, GIC and Altimeter participating.

target: Blackstone Green Private Credit Fund IV
description: Fourth vehicle in Blackstone's private-credit strategy lending to energy-transition and digital-infrastructure borrowers (power/utilities, data centers, chip financing). Reported to be targeting at least $8B, following predecessor Fund III's $7.1B close with a 15% net IRR as of mid-2026. Fundraising was still underway, not confirmed closed, at time of writing.
